name: pgvector Explorer
description: Inspect PostgreSQL pgvector tables, HNSW/IVFFlat vector indexes, run cosine/L2 similarity searches, and visualize embedding clusters.

commands.title: Build pgvector Similarity SQL
commands.description: Generates parameterized cosine (<=>), L2 (<->), or inner-product (<#>) similarity SQL queries.

commands.title: Compute Local Cosine Similarity
commands.description: Computes exact cosine similarity between two embedding vectors for debugging RAG pipelines.

commands.title: HNSW / IVFFlat Index Advisor
commands.description: Recommends optimal pgvector index DDL based on vector dimensions and row count.
